repairs_from_round1.finding: The complete rights and contributions statement fits on page 5; the next page begins the preface.
Direct 144 dpi viewing of the new pages 16 and 17 confirms the Chapter 2 final paragraph is intact as six lines on page 17 with its complete footnote; ordinary chapter-ending white space remains.
Chapter 5 ends with several complete paragraphs and its footnote on page 25.
Chapter 7 ends on a substantially occupied page; repeat reference 3 points back to its first complete note.
The Chapter 6 final paragraph and complete note 14 fit together on page 28; no separate continuation page.
Chapter 14 ends on page 64 with body text and the complete present footnote; no separate continuation page.
Chapter 11 now ends with several paragraphs on page 54 rather than a five-line tail page.
The TOC gives Chapter 28 and its page number a separate, clear right-hand column gap.

remaining_issues.finding: TOC still hyphenates long titles (e.g. Fail-/ure, Mathe-/matical, Refer-/ences) and justifies some short lines with wide spaces. The lead requested ragged-right no-hyphenation TOC entries before release.
remaining_issues.status: awaiting local TOC style change and pixel-diff reinspection

limitations: This is an English-pages-1–74 review, not a whole-book visual certification.
